item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇲🇻 On September 25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives Iruthisham Adam held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Foreign Ministers discussed prospects for further developing the friendly Russian-Maldivian relations . During the meeting, the Sides expressed their mutual interest in maintaining regular political dialogue and expanding practical cooperation, including in tourism. #RussiaMaldives

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Iraq
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇶 On September 25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Iraq Fuad Hussein held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Foreign Ministers discussed practical aspects of further developing the traditionally friendly Russian-Iraqi relations . The Sides reaffirmed their mutual interest in strengthening trust-based political dialogue and expanding mutually beneficial cooperation in trade, the economy, the humanitarian sphere and other areas. They also exchanged views on current global and regional issues , with a particular focus on the situation in the Persian Gulf region. The Ministers emphasised the importance of stepping up international efforts to achieve t he earliest possible de-escalation and ensure political and diplomatic settlement of existing conflicts in the Middle East . #RussiaIraq

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs, African Cooperation and Moroccan Expatriates
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇲🇦 On September 25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs, African Cooperation and Moroccan Expatriates Nasser Bourita held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . During the meeting, the Ministers discussed priority tasks for further strengthening the traditionally friendly Russian-Moroccan relations . It was emphasised that multifaceted cooperation is developing in line with the Declaration on a Deep Strategic Partnership of March 15, 2016 . The Ministers reaffirmed their commitment to maintaining effective foreign policy coordination on current regional issues, including with a view to resolving the Western Sahara issue and other ongoing conflicts through political and diplomatic means , based on the universally recognised principles of international law and the UN Charter . #RussiaMorocco

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 25, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Prime Minister of Barbados

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 25, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay Mario Lubetkin
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇺🇾 On September 25, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay Mario Lubetkin held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Sides discussed current issues in Russia-Uruguay relations , including bilateral contacts at various levels and trade and economic cooperation. The Foreign Ministers exchanged views on the current international situation and discussed multilateral cooperation, primarily at the UN. They emphasised their interest in reinvigorating the #RussiaCELAC political dialogue mechanism and strengthening ties between the EAEU and MERCOSUR member states , taking into account Uruguay’s rotating chairmanship of these Latin American associations. #RussiaUruguay

🎙
President of Russia Vladimir Putin’s
answers to media questions
(St Petersburg, September 25, 2026)
Key talking points
:
•
The Russian Armed Forces’ recent actions
were yet again
retaliatory
[to Ukraine’s reckless provocations] and proved so painful and devastating for the adversary that they are now
once again actively raising the issue of ceasefires in several areas
– energy and airspace, as they put it.
But they were the ones who started all of this.
• Is this some kind of children’s game to them? They must therefore
feel the impact of Russia’s retaliatory strikes
and understand that
no provocations or escalation will bring them the results they seek
. They are only making their own situat
ion worse.
• All these moves towards so-called reconciliation and proposals to resume negotiations are on the table. All of this is possible. But after everything they have done,
we will think very carefully about what action we need to take in response
.
❗️
I want to stress once again:
we are not preparing for any military action against Europe
. We have no such plans and, most importantly, no grounds or real motives for escalating the situation with Europe, whatever anyone may say, including those in the Baltic states.
•
We will continue to stand up for the rights of our compatriots, within the framework of international law
. We have never intended to use other means, have never used them and have no intention of doing so.
•
We welcome negotiations between the US and China
. Why? Because these are the world’s two largest economies. How they resolve their differences and the problems arising from illegitimate US sanctions, and what agreements they reach, will influence the entire global economy, including our own.
•
The APEC Summit in China
is a major, important event, and I have been invited
. I believe it would be useful to take part in such a forum. I have told President Xi Jinping this as well. I intend to participate. But, as I have said,
the final decision will depend on the situation in Russia.
